optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, analytic gradients, float64; shared maxiter=300, adaptation maxiter=100, ftol=1e-10, gtol=1e-6, maxls=30
loss: mean categorical cross entropy + lambda/2 * sum(parameter squares); M1 personal penalty averaged over training people, basis penalty summed; B2 biases unpenalized; B3 and M1 support penalties summed
B0: add-one smoothing of training-block class counts
B4: exp(cosine_similarity-1) weights; weighted class sum plus alpha*B2 probability divided by weight sum plus alpha
selection: development macro-person NLL at 16, mean loss over three support draws; M1 ensemble probabilities across all three fit seeds; deterministic first grid entry tie break
initialization: B2 zeros; M1 normal(0,0.05) V and u with numpy default_rng(seed), zero b; new-person parameters zeros
final_batch: B0-B4 and selected M1 ensemble at 0/4/16/64, draws 101/211/307; M1 individual seeds at 16; B3/B4/M1 ten fixed history derangements at 16; full-cohort and evaluator disagreement-subset metrics; paired bootstrap primary, M1-vs-B2, M1-vs-B3
derangements: numpy default_rng(919), rejection-sampled permutations of canonical split-person order, reject any fixed point; generate once per split
bootstrap: 2000 independent person/group multinomial resamples, seed 1701, percentile 95%, within-person group-weight normalization; reject empty intersections, max 20000 attempts
